real_qa.q: What was Hadley Nightingale's first real estate investment mistake and how much did he lose on his initial property purchase?
real_qa.r: Hadley purchased a block of land for $765,000 with a $100,000 overdraft around 2006-2007. He had a verbal corn contract with a farmer that fell through, the contractor kept pushing back the small job, and the crop degraded to grain worth only $23,000 instead of the expected $80,000. After working for approximately 10 years to keep the property afloat throughout his 20s, he eventually broke even and walked away, receiving $200,000 to $300,000 in tax losses that allowed him to pay no income tax for the next five years.
real_qa.requete: Hadley Nightingale real estate investment first mistake

real_qa.q: How much did Hadley Nightingale earn per hour in New Zealand versus Australia, and why did he move?
real_qa.r: Hadley was earning $13 an hour in New Zealand on dairy farming, so he moved to Australia where he could earn $20 an hour working in mining and long-haul trucking. His philosophy was that by nearly doubling his wage, he could work harder and longer hours to service the debt from his failed property investment, driving 16 to 18 hour days to increase his income.
real_qa.requete: Hadley Nightingale salary New Zealand Australia mining

real_qa.q: What real estate investment model did Hadley Nightingale discover after his initial farming failure?
real_qa.r: After his first real estate deal failed and he worked through multi-level marketing exposure to personal development, Hadley listened to Rich Dad Poor Dad repeatedly and realized that other people make money from real estate, concluding he must have been using the wrong model. He came back to New Zealand after nine to ten years in Australia and decided to pursue real estate investment using a different approach based on the lessons from that book.
real_qa.requete: Rich Dad Poor Dad real estate investment model

real_qa.q: What personal development mentors influenced Hadley Nightingale's shift from mining work to wealth building through real estate?
real_qa.r: Hadley was introduced to Jim Rohn and Zig Ziglar through multi-level marketing exposure, specifically through Herbalife. These mentors helped him fine-tune his mindset to realize that where he was in his mining career did not have to be where he finished, and introduced him to concepts like Automobile University - reading books and gaining education to become more valuable to the market.

real_qa.q: How much tax relief did Hadley Nightingale receive from his failed farming investment over how many years?
real_qa.r: From his failed real estate and farming venture that lasted approximately nine to ten years, Hadley accumulated $200,000 to $300,000 worth of tax losses. These losses allowed him to pay no income tax for the next five years after he walked away from the property.
